123093: He is Sakurai's senior. In the past, he worked in a different department at Moriko's workplace. He often interferes between Sakurai and Moriko.
123094: Kazuomi is a college student working part-time at a convenience store near Moriko's house.
123095: Morioko's character in the game Fruits de Mer.
123096: Lily is a kindhearted healer in the "@Home Party" guild. She spends too much money for gacha rolls.
123097: Kanbe is the master of the "@House Party" guild. He may be rough-sounding and acts as a strict master, but he thinks of his guild members more than anyone. He is a shield-carrying assassin.
123098: Lilac is a gossip-loving sorcerer in the "@House Party" guild. In real life, her player is Nao and she's a university student.
